post.title: Chart-to-Text Caption Generation - BLIP Fine-Tunning
post.description: For my course project, I plan to fine-tune a multimodal LLM (such as BLIP or BLIP-2) to generate natural-language captions for financial stock-chart images. This project lies at the intersection of statistical NLP, vision-language modeling, and financial language understanding.
